source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05: the table's own CA(28; 2, 449, 3) (array CA_28_2_449_3_4123e4fb; generalized direct product, tools/own_arrays/prod2.py) plus one row, then column extension at fixed N (programs/caex.c after the CA Extender of Torres-Jimenez, Acevedo-Juarez and Avila-George 2021, with the annealing of Avila-George, Torres-Jimenez and Hernandez 2012) to 520, 548 and 582 columns, then column large-neighbourhood search (programs/pool.c, kcl.c, lns3.py: remove many columns, collect columns compatible with all kept columns, find a larger mutually compatible set by seeded tabu search) to 610 columns; exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
construction: Our own product array plus a row then column extension at fixed N then column large-neighbourhood search
notes: ties the Torres-Jimenez size 29 at k = 610; no array of his is an ingredient or start; the CA Extender and the annealer are credited as methods
